item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?

Here's one that's still around. SCP-843.

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded: SCP-714 comes to mind. The horrendously awful original version of SCP-182 is another example, though thankfully not the current version.

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded: Can you come up with an example? Cause I never found one like that.

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded: And seriously, "no origin given" is better than bad one. "My OC went on vacation and found this thing, in public, yet the Foundation never heard of it before." was probably the most popular one back then, and thankfully very few of them still remain to this day.

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded:
Slight clarification on the above: not all anomalies have an origin written into the original article. This doesn't mean that there aren't tales about said anomalies, nor does it mean such tales cannot be written.

With regards to said tales, readers can look at our SCP tales by series listings, for example, the Series I tales listing: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-series-1-tales-edition

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded: Not all skips get an origin. Especially not those in series 1.

item.title: Re: SCP 096 Origin?
item.content:encoded: I don't remember where I saw this, but someone said that they think SCP-096's lover has bid him farewell, and in his grief, he became "that thing".

item.title: SCP 096 Origin?
